svg.title: FIFO handoff can coexist with reordered completion
svg.desc: Constructed milliseconds • capacity 2 • reject-on-Full • three downstream workers
svg.text: FIFO handoff can coexist with reordered completion
Constructed milliseconds • capacity 2 • reject-on-Full • three downstream workers
Five offers, three accepted
Time 0: A/B accepted; C/D rejected
Time 1: dequeue A; time 2: accept E
Time 3: dequeue B; time 4: dequeue E
Handoff order A, B, E
Queue waits: A 1 ms; B 3 ms; E 2 ms
Mean queue residence = 2 ms
Queue inventory at time 4 = 0
Completion order B, E, A
B completes 5; E completes 6; A completes 7
At time 4, all three remain unfinished
At time 7: 5 offered = 3 success + 2 reject
Drain extends beyond an empty queue
Dequeued work retains its resource claims
Shutdown must reconcile accepted outcomes
Unknown completion cannot authorize reuse
Separate overload fixture: 500 offers/s − 400 dequeues/s = 100 items/s backlog growth.
64-item fluid fill time = 0.64 s; finite buffering does not create consumer capacity.
